hypothesis: A current-run cohort audit must exclude rolling backend fills whose explicit origin_run_id is outside the compatible run identities proved by the selected asset ledgers, while retaining origin-less legacy fills so unproven projection mismatches remain visible.
decision: Retain the report-only origin-run scope filter in the current source. The fix changes no live process, order, strategy, exit, sizing, leverage, or risk behavior. Preserve the defective immutable audit as the regression observation and use the corrected immutable audit for current-run attribution.
falsifier: Reject or revise this repair if a compatible-run projected fill is excluded, an explicitly incompatible origin_run_id remains in a current-run report, a missing-origin projected fill is silently discarded, compatible-profile all-history restart tests regress, or authoritative fill and projected-fill counts diverge again for the same stable ledger snapshot.
limitations: The corrected report was generated from a later stable snapshot than the defective report, although both snapshots retained the same 12 authoritative current-run fills and the same three closed trades.
Projected fills without origin_run_id remain visible by design; their scope must still be resolved through authoritative identity reconciliation rather than silently inferred.
This repair establishes current-run audit attribution consistency, not strategy profitability or live execution quality.
The live V58 process still runs the sealed pre-repair implementation and this report-only source change will load only during a separately authorized verified restart.
